status: Draft researcher review prompts; no validated score or automatic adaptation

rules.title: Difficulty following the lesson
rules.action: Review instructions and concept transitions with participants; check whether the wording or presentation caused difficulty.

rules.title: Too much information at once
rules.action: Review simultaneous information and scrolling burden within this frozen presentation. Register any stimulus change as a new version.

rules.title: Difficulty concentrating on key information
rules.action: Ask which elements competed for attention and inspect their hierarchy; browser events alone cannot identify the cause.

rules.title: Uncomfortable lesson pace
rules.action: Review navigation and narration controls. The answer does not say whether the lesson felt too fast or too slow; ask during the approved review.

rules.title: High reported mental effort
rules.action: Review effort alongside baseline knowledge and clarity. Keep this single item separate from other questionnaire scales.

rules.title: Interim topic review reported
rules.action: Inspect reported review sources and the preregistered retention sensitivity plan. Do not automatically exclude the response or attribute retention changes to the interface.
